name: MailKite Self-Hosted Programmable Mail Server
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-licensed self-hosted mail server with SMTP inbound/submission, IMAP, reference SQLite backend, REST API and web console; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Pre-1.0 software: reference backend and console are newer than the production SMTP/IMAP edges. Provide your own server, DNS, TLS, storage and mail deliverability; external relays and MailKite Cloud are separate and may cost money. AGPL-3.0 source-sharing obligations apply when modified software is offered over a network.
